purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Capital letters do not create a second United States
question: Does changing the capitalization of United States of America create a different legal entity, especially on a U.S. passport?
bluf: The passport's authority comes from federal law and State Department issuance, not the capitalization on its cover.
evidence_cutoff_note: Focused official-source review of the 2026 commemorative passport page, passport-issuance statute, National Archives Articles transcript, GPO production role, ICAO machine-readable-document standard, October 1 Tenth Circuit opinion, 28 U.S.C. § 3002 and the 1871 District of Columbia Organic Act. This is not a complete census of passport designs or all capitalization cases.
use_note: Use to resolve capitalization and passport-cover claims. Preserve genuine actor, capacity and statutory-definition distinctions, but do not infer a second legal person from typography, abbreviations or machine-readable formatting.
